configuration.baseline_policy: always included; measured once per degree before other candidates
configuration.cache_policy: jax.clear_caches before every candidate, then set BLOCK_Q/BLOCK_K/NUM_WARPS/NUM_STAGES
configuration.input_distribution: fixed independent normal(0,1); Q/K scaled before BF16 conversion
configuration.memory: compiler estimates from time_program; not measured allocator peak

parity.limitation: tile-invariance check against the same semantic kernel, not an independent correctness proof
parity.objective: finite-only gate; cancellation-sensitive scalar error recorded
parity.scope: global and every batch/head; exact zero references require exact zero errors

configuration.reference_storage: independent read-only host arrays; never cached device outputs
configuration.timing: synchronized compiled calls; compilation, reference transfers, and parity checks excluded
